spec.title: LLM Overview
spec.description: Start here: requests, spend, tokens, latency and errors of every LLM call that Claude Platform and OpenRouter traced, and that crok reported itself for Codex, GLM, DeepSeek and other providers without traces of their own.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: LLM API calls in the time range: Claude Messages API requests, OpenRouter generations and the calls crok reported for providers without traces of their own. Grafana Cloud runs a TraceQL metrics query over 25 hours at most, so keep the time range at 24 hours or less.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed. The rest is what crok worked out per call: the provider's cost when it reports one, else the model's standard API price. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input plus output tokens. Input includes prompt-cache reads and writes.

panels.title: Claude cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of Claude input tokens read from the prompt cache. A cache read costs a tenth of input or less, so higher is cheaper. Long agent sessions usually stay above 80%. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of calls whose span ended with an error status: rate limits, overloads, invalid requests, upstream failures. A call the user interrupted in crok is not counted as failed. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of calls finished faster than this, from request start to the last streamed token. Tempo buckets durations to powers of two, so read it as a range. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Week over week (recorded history, any time range)
Spend, week over week
panels.description: Spend in the last 7 days and how much more (or less, below zero) than the 7 days before. Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length.

panels.title: Requests, week over week
panels.description: Calls in the last 7 days, compared with the 7 days before. Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length.

panels.title: Tokens, week over week
panels.description: Input plus output tokens in the last 7 days, compared with the 7 days before. Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length.

panels.title: Error rate, week over week
panels.description: Failed calls divided by all calls (a call the user interrupted in crok is not a failure). Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length.

panels.title: Spend per day by provider (last 14 days)
panels.description: Spend in each UTC day of the last 14 days, by provider (codex, glm and deepseek as crok reported them). From the recorded history, whatever the time range above. Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed.

panels.title: Requests per day by provider (last 14 days)
panels.description: Calls in each UTC day of the last 14 days, by provider. From the recorded history.

panels.title: Requests per minute
panels.description: Calls per minute: Claude Platform and OpenRouter by source, crok's reports by provider.

panels.title: Tokens by source
panels.description: Input plus output tokens in each time bucket. The legend total is the sum over the range.

panels.title: Spend over time
panels.description: Spend in each time bucket by model (claude-* models through Claude Platform, provider/model ids through OpenRouter, the rest as crok reported them). The legend total is the spend over the range. Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed. The rest is what crok worked out per call: the provider's cost when it reports one, else the model's standard API price. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Spend by model
panels.description: Spend over the time range for each model, largest first. Claude Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K tokens pay five times the base rates; that extra has its own bar. Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed. The rest is what crok worked out per call: the provider's cost when it reports one, else the model's standard API price. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Call duration percentiles by source (crok's reports by provider). p50 is the median.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Failed calls by source and error type, for example rate_limit_error or overloaded_error; crok's reports by provider and error category (rate_limit, server_error, auth_error, client_error, timeout, sdk_error for a connection that failed). Empty is good.

panels.title: Requests by model
panels.description: Calls over the time range for each requested model.

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Input plus output tokens over the time range for each requested model.

panels.title: p95 latency by model
panels.description: 95th percentile call duration for each model over the time range. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Latest LLM calls
panels.description: The most recent calls. Cost is what OpenRouter billed; Cost (crok) is what crok reported, empty for crok 2.0.0 and older (the spend panels price those calls from their tokens). Click a trace ID to open the whole trace.
